verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party natural-language command interface for Unreal Engine. Python editor scripting, the Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API, and the Neural Network Engine (NNE) are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not natural-language operation. The probe also found no official Epic MCP; the community MCP servers it lists are third-party and unmaintained, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
